update.title: App updates
update.autoCheckHelp: Off by default. When on, asks GitHub for the latest version at most once a day. It only notifies; nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version
update.availableCheckFailed: New version {version} available; the latest check failed
update.failed: The check failed. Please try again later.
update.rateLimited: Checking too often. Please try again shortly.
update.openFailed: Could not open the release page
update.notifyBody: Version {version} is out. Open Advanced in Settings to view it; nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
